T: Breakfast with Katy's family. Then the dragon.
D: A San Francisco valet is pulled back into the world of his father's secret organisation.
P: Serve the mains when Shang-Chi and Katy have breakfast with her family.
S: Rice simmered slowly in chicken stock with ginger until creamy, topped with shredded chicken, spring onion, soy and fried shallots.
the fight on the runaway bus in San Francisco
Pork scotch fillet roasted with hoisin and honey until sticky, sliced and stuffed into steamed bao with cucumber and spring onion.
the fight club up the side of a Macau tower
Pork and prawn filling with ginger folded into dumpling wrappers, steamed in bamboo baskets for 8 minutes, with chilli oil and black vinegar.
M: the hidden village of Ta Lo
Whole snapper steamed with ginger and spring onion, finished with hot oil and soy, with rice and stir-fried greens.
Shang-Chi and Katy parking cars for a living
Beef strips seared hot in a wok, broccoli and garlic tossed through, egg noodles and oyster sauce added and stir-fried until glossy, served in takeaway boxes.
W: the great protector dragon of Ta Lo
Mango purée warmed with sugar and gelatine, stirred into evaporated milk, set in glasses for 4 hours, topped with thin mango slices laid like scales.
K: Shang-Chi and Katy's laid-back life in San Francisco
Black tea with milk and brown sugar syrup, poured over cooked tapioca pearls and ice.

s.how: Simmer 150g jasmine rice in 1.5L chicken stock with ginger for 90 minutes until creamy. Poach and shred a chicken breast. Top bowls with the chicken, spring onion, soy and fried shallots.

s.note: the fight on the runaway bus in San Francisco
s.how: Roast 600g pork scotch fillet brushed with 4 tbsp hoisin and 2 tbsp honey at 200C for 35 minutes until sticky, then slice. Steam 12 bao buns and fill with pork, sliced cucumber and spring onion.

m.note: the hidden village of Ta Lo
m.how: Score a 1.2kg whole snapper and steam over sliced ginger and spring onion for 12 minutes. Top with fresh spring onion, pour over 3 tbsp soy, then 4 tbsp smoking hot oil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and bok choy.

w.note: the great protector dragon of Ta Lo
w.how: Blitz 2 mangoes with 60g sugar. Soak 4 gelatine sheets, dissolve in a little warm purée and stir through with 375ml evaporated milk. Set in glasses for 4 hours and top with thin mango slices laid like scales.

d.note: Shang-Chi and Katy's laid-back life in San Francisco
d.how: Cook 150g tapioca pearls as the packet says and soak in syrup made from 100g brown sugar and 100ml water. Brew 4 black tea bags in 500ml water and mix with 500ml milk. Pour over the pearls and ice.
